eligibility_evidence: Xceed maintains numerous international certifications, including COPC, ISO standards for business continuity, quality, occupational health and safety, environment, and information security, providing a stable and compliant environment for technology professionals.

This full-time, on-site role is based in Cairo, Egypt, and involves supervising a team of developers, reviewing code, and ensuring adherence to best practices in .NET development and secure software engineering.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Day-to-day tasks also include managing database interactions, coordinating integrations with internal and external systems, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, and providing technical guidance and mentoring for team members. Qualifications Strong skills in Software Development and Programming, with advanced experience in .NET technologies (e.g., C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) and object-oriented design. Hands-on experience with Databases, including relational database design, SQL optimization, and working with enterprise-grade database management systems. Proficiency in front-end technologies such as Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), along with a solid understanding of modern web UI/UX principles.
